svg.title: We Transitioned Prisma Accelerate to IPv6 Without Anyone Noticing
svg.desc: The figure $3.60 set in large type above the line "per public IPv4 address, per month" — the AWS charge, announced in July 2023, that pushed Prisma Accelerate's thousands of EC2 instances to an IPv6-first architecture. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.

g.text: per public IPv4 address, per month
on thousands of Prisma Accelerate EC2 instances
